sourceBoundary: The percentage charts are captured as supplied visual reference signals only. They are not treated as live market statistics or current benchmark truth.
goal: Map programming languages to the SEIS product surfaces, agent lanes, production layers, and long-term native/system roadmap without turning every language into an active dependency.
priorityModel: use the smallest language set needed for the current SEIS layer
separate current implementation from planned capability
do not rewrite working surfaces only to chase trend charts
activate extra languages only when a scoped PR proves why they are needed

purposeGroups.label: Web Sites and Product UI
purposeGroups.seisUse: SEIS public website, Desktop OS local demo, Search, Code, Design, Cloud, Store, Agents, portfolio and product pages.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Keep current HTML/CSS/JavaScript demo stable; add TypeScript only where contracts and maintainability justify it.

purposeGroups.label: Desktop Applications
purposeGroups.seisUse: Future native desktop helpers, Apple-first SEIS app family, Windows utilities, and local developer tools.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Document platform targets before adding native runtime code.

purposeGroups.label: Operating Systems and System UX
purposeGroups.seisUse: SEIS OS reference lab, Linux-like desktop route, system UX research, local shell behavior, and future lower-level tooling.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Use as architecture inspiration only; make no kernel or real OS claim until there is a separate system runtime project.

purposeGroups.label: Mobile Applications
purposeGroups.seisUse: Apple-first iOS/iPadOS direction, future Android companion, mobile SEIS command surfaces.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Start with SwiftUI architecture notes before native app implementation.

purposeGroups.label: Game, 3D, and Interactive Worlds
purposeGroups.seisUse: Mythic Gacha, creative worlds, 3D/motion systems, interactive showcases, simulation-style UI experiments.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Keep current browser game/showcase routes local; plan engine-based work separately.

purposeGroups.label: AI, ML, and Data Science
purposeGroups.seisUse: AI Core, RAG, evaluation, embeddings, knowledge indexing, data analysis, model governance, future analytics.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Use Python and JSON contracts first; add data notebooks or pipelines only after data boundary approval.

purposeGroups.label: Backend, API, and Enterprise Services
purposeGroups.seisUse: Read-only local server, provider router, API contracts, future durable backend, enterprise-grade services.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Keep current Node read-only boundary; document Java/Spring and Python service lanes before implementation.

purposeGroups.label: DevOps, Cloud, and Automation
purposeGroups.seisUse: Validation scripts, GitHub Actions, deployment readiness, cloud plans, local automation, SSH-safe onboarding.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Maintain dry-run and validation-first automation; no deployment or SSH without approval.

purposeGroups.label: Security and Governance
purposeGroups.seisUse: Secret scanning, policy checks, permission models, audit logs, rate limits, provider boundaries, rollback gates.
purposeGroups.nextAction: Add language-aware security checks before enabling any live backend/provider surface.
